cars.specification_market: Original 608-PS V12 DB11 coupe, selected international manufacturer press reference dated 28 February 2017. Count the DB11 core model once across engines, AMR, coupe/Volante bodies and years. The factory’s 2018 core-range presentation lists DB11 separately from Vantage and DBS Superleggera; the latter’s DB11-derived structure is explicitly acknowledged, not mistaken for an alias or ignored. Older DB9 is a previous architecture. No later 639-PS AMR, V8 or DBS output, prototype tune, US test time, mass, dimensions, injection type, torque plateau or power peak imported. Displacement is factory nominal 5.2 litres, not an inferred exact cc figure.
cars.summary: The DB11 introduced a new bonded-aluminium architecture and twin-turbo V12 at a turning point in Aston Martin’s road-car programme. A contemporary production-car test supports its engine and tactile grand-touring character, with noise and less overtly sporting behaviour acknowledged. One DB11 core family is represented across V12, V8, AMR and Volante versions.
